 As per the office-report, there is no delay in 
filing the present Special Appeal. Hence, the Delay 
Condonation Application is dismissed as 
infructuous. 
 Issue notice to the respondent. 
 Mr. M.C. Pant, the learned counsel for the 
respondent, has already accepted the brief, hence, 
there is no requirement to send him a formal 
notice. 
 Six weeks’ time is granted to the respondent to 
file counter-affidavit. 
 List this matter after eight weeks. 
 The effect and operation of the order dated 
09.12.2021 shall remain stayed till the next date of  listing. 
 Urgent certified copy of this order be issued to 
the parties, as per Rules.
